definitions.explanation: A home that one has recently moved into. Often used when talking about moving house, newlyweds setting up home, or buying a new place.

examples.japanese: {新居|しんきょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧。
examples.english: I moved into a new home.

examples.japanese: {新居|しんきょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me the address of your new home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{新居|しんきょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: The two got married and started their life in their new home.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly used in the context of moving or starting a new chapter in life, especially marriage. The word emphasizes the newness of the residence rather than the act of moving.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新居|しんきょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧: to move into a new home
- {新居|しんきょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧: to set up a new home
- {新居|しんきょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: life in a new home
- {新居|しんきょ}⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧: housewarming gift
